full catalog 4000Plus Bondtester Product catalog summary Overview: The Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is an advanced bondtester known for its precision and versatility, suitable for industries like semiconductors and microelectronics.
The test range of the Nordson DAGE 4000Plus is from 250 milligrams to 500 kilograms, suitable for both standard and specialized applications.
Features • Carrier Tape Tension: Tension tests for all sizes and types of carrier tapes can be conducted using a variety of loading tools, including hooks and jaw tests.
• Passivation Layer Shear Force: The combination of software and specialized pushing blades provides a solution for testing shear forces at constrained locations of the passivation layer.
